description.en: Locks talk interaction for a pair of character handles together (a two-handle variant of CMND_SET_TALK_LOCK_CHARA), e.g. two NPCs that should stop being talkable as a set. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation and its similarity to CMND_SET_TALK_LOCK_CHARA.

example.code:
// Lock talk interaction for a pair of NPCs together
CMND_SET_TALK_LOCK_PAIR(hNpcA, hNpcB);
